title: Who May Overrule the Agent? Evidence-Gated Authority in LLM Review Institutions
abstract: arXiv:2611.05390v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multi-agent language-model systems often add a reviewer to improve an upstream agent's decision. Yet a reviewer can both repair errors and replace decisions that were already correct. We study this as a problem of institutional jurisdiction: conditional on the same proposal, task information, model, and review output, when is the reviewer authorized to make its recommendation binding? We compare broad override authority with an evidence gate that permits replacement only after the reviewer produces a mechanically valid record of a binding-constraint violation and a compliant repair. Across two locally run open-weight models, 96 spatial-policy tasks, and a 96-task portfolio-transfer benchmark, the gate sharply reduces corruption of correct proposals while retaining most repairs of violations. translated_title: 谁有权推翻智能体？LLM审查机构中的证据门控授权
translated_abstract: 多智能体语言模型系统通常会添加一个审查者来改进上游智能体的决策。然而，审查者既能修复错误，也可能替换原本正确的决策。我们将此作为一个机构管辖权问题来研究：在相同的提案、任务信息、模型和审查输出的条件下，审查者何时被授权使其建议具有约束力？我们比较了宽泛的推翻权限与证据门控机制——后者只有在审查者生成关于约束性规则违反及合规修复的机械有效记录后，才允许替换提案。在两个本地运行的开源权重模型、96个空间策略任务以及一个96任务的投资组合迁移基准测试中，该门控机制显著减少了对正确提案的破坏，同时保留了对违规行为的大多数修复。这种权衡的方向部分由规则本身决定；其幅度则取决于审查者的状态转换和上游提案的状态。
tldr: 本文提出一种“证据门控”审查权限机制，要求LLM审查者必须先产生约束违反与合规修复的有效记录才能推翻上游智能体的提案，实验证明该机制能在大幅减少误改正确决策的同时保留大部分错误修复能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an "evidence gate" for reviewer authority in LLM review institutions, which permits overriding upstream agent proposals only after the reviewer produces a mechanically valid record of a constraint violation and a compliant repair, and shows that it sharply reduces corruption of correct proposals while retaining most repairs.
